title: On the Origin and Publication of the FFT Paper
lineage: Retrospective account by the 1965 paper’s two authors, archived by the University of Pennsylvania. Same participants as the 1965 publication.

passages.locator: p. 8, from Garwin’s conversation with Tukey through the IBM seminar
passages.note: The authors recall Tukey presenting a factorisation in 1963, Garwin passing the notes to IBM’s computing centre, and Cooley deriving and programming an in-place radix-2 method before the patentability inquiry.

passages.locator: pp. 8–9, patentability inquiry and drafting of paper
passages.note: Cooley asked Tukey about earlier work after the radix-2 program and seminar. Tukey named Yates and Good, distinguishing Good’s restriction to mutually prime factors. Cooley then recalls preparing the draft including the general-radix method. The account leaves the date of Tukey’s first contact with Good’s work open.
